requirements.reportingCadence: Monthly KPI review with weekly launch huddles

notes: Asset manager said executive floors, lobby glass, and restroom supplies are what trigger tenant emails first.
Buyer wants a self-performed day team with a named supervisor rather than a subcontractor carousel.
The incumbent has had recurring inspection misses on floor care and consumable restocking.
Ridgeview is rate-sensitive, but they will pay to avoid another ugly first 30 days and repeated floor-care callbacks.

operatorAssumptions.text: Weekend event cleanup volume will stay inside the proposed staffing envelope during the first contract quarter.
Ridgeview will accept a buyer-visible launch dashboard during the first 30 days.

reviewCheckpoints.title: Content Plan Review
reviewCheckpoints.objective: Validate story structure, proof plan, and section intent before evaluator-style drafting.
exitCriteria: Outline and section intent are stable.
Evaluation factors are mapped to sections and proof.
Major content gaps have owners and due dates.
Win themes and discriminators are explicit.

reviewCheckpoints.title: Red Review (Evaluator View)
reviewCheckpoints.objective: Assess the proposal experience as a buyer would and identify rework before final polish.
exitCriteria: Buyer questions are answered from an evaluator view.
Strengths and proof are visible in the experience.
Pricing narrative aligns with the delivery approach.
Major evaluator-facing defects have disposition owners.

reviewCheckpoints.title: Gold Readiness Review
reviewCheckpoints.objective: Confirm production readiness, export fallback, and final decision controls before release.
exitCriteria: Final files and forms are present in the controlled package.
Executive, pricing, and contract approvals are captured.
Naming, attachments, and export packaging are locked.
Submission and contingency paths are confirmed.

operatorActions.title: Prepare evaluator review packet
operatorActions.closeCondition: Promoted concept, export summary, and issue log are ready for evaluator walkthrough.

operatorActions.title: Draft value bridge for rate-sensitive buyer questions
operatorActions.closeCondition: Value bridge shows what Ridgeview gets for the rate: staffed daytime response, launch control, and fewer floor-care callbacks.

workingStory.summaryVariantId: Make the building easier to manage
workingStory.operatorNotes: Open with what Ridgeview sees at 2 PM: executive space reset, restroom supplies full, and one supervisor owning the noise. Then defend rate with the cleaner launch and fewer callbacks.

selection.summaryVariantId: Make the building easier to manage
selection.operatorNotes: Make the buyer picture a calmer property team by day three: executive areas reset, restrooms stocked, launch questions answered, and no one debating who owns the issue.
Use this when the buyer wants one name behind staffing, launch follow-through, and service recovery instead of another vendor stack to chase.
